patterns.description: Las cards sobre condiciones de elegibilidad para Discover contradicen: la card oficial declara criterios sin especificar, mientras cards de vendedores reportan un umbral explícito de $10 en ventas previas como condición de acceso.

signal_summaries.SC-R1-073: Help center (July 2024): product listed on Discover if category selected and unspecified eligibility criteria satisfied
signal_summaries.SC-R1-055: Seller blog (July 2025): Gumroad will not promote via Discover until seller earns first $10
signal_summaries.SC-R1-062: Seller forum (March 2026): 26 products, zero Discover views; attributes to Gumroad Discover only showing products after first sale

components.label: Polo A — criterios de elegibilidad oficiales no especificados
components.summary: Help center states eligibility criteria exist but does not specify them

components.label: Polo B — umbral de $10 reportado por vendedores
components.summary: Sellers report specific $10 earning threshold as the Discover eligibility condition

patterns.routing_rationale: Same-actor filter applied: SC-R1-073 actor=seller, SC-R1-055 actor=seller, SC-R1-062 actor=seller. All Signal IDs across both poles share actor value 'seller'. Routed rejected_grouping with reason same_actor_discrepancy.

patterns.description: Las cards sobre el fee de Gumroad Discover se contradicen sobre el porcentaje total: una card de la página de precios declara 30% para ventas vía Discover web, mientras cards del help center declaran 40% para ventas vía app móvil de Discover.

signal_summaries.SC-R1-006: Pricing page: 30% fee when new customers find and buy via Gumroad Discover marketplace
signal_summaries.SC-R1-036: Help center: mobile app sales total fee is 40% (10% Gumroad + 30% App Store/Google Play)
signal_summaries.SC-R1-038: Help center (July 2024): 40% fee for all in-app Gumroad Discover sales; all app sales final

components.label: Polo A — fee Discover declarado en 30% (canal web)
components.summary: Pricing page states 30% fee for Discover-originated sales

components.label: Polo B — fee Discover declarado en 40% (canal app móvil)
components.summary: Help center articles state 40% total fee for in-app Discover sales (10% Gumroad + 30% app store)

patterns.routing_rationale: Same-actor filter: SC-R1-006 actor=marketplace, SC-R1-036 actor=marketplace, SC-R1-038 actor=seller. Not all the same actor — filter does not apply. The 30% vs 40% applies to different channels (web Discover vs mobile app Discover). Polo A has only 1 card (pricing page). The pricing page does not clarify the app/web distinction, creating potential seller confusion about actual Discover fees. Routed needs_audit because Polo A has single-card support and the channel distinction may not be obvious to sellers reading the pricing page.

patterns.description: Las cards sobre el control de la plataforma en reembolsos contradicen: cards del ToS y help center declaran que Gumroad puede emitir reembolsos discrecionalmente y que los vendedores deben reembolsar a Gumroad, mientras una card del help center declara que Gumroad como merchant no puede prevenir chargebacks.

signal_summaries.SC-R1-018: ToS (Jan 2025): Gumroad handles refunds/chargebacks at sole discretion; sellers responsible for reimbursing Gumroad
signal_summaries.SC-R1-034: Help center (May 2023): Gumroad reserves right to issue refunds within 90 days even overriding seller no-refund policy
signal_summaries.SC-R1-037: Help center (Oct 2022): Gumroad as merchant cannot prevent chargebacks from happening but will dispute in some cases

components.label: Polo A — Gumroad ejerce discreción unilateral sobre reembolsos
components.summary: ToS and help center state Gumroad has sole discretion and can override seller refund policy

components.label: Polo B — Gumroad declara no poder prevenir chargebacks
components.summary: Help center states Gumroad as merchant cannot prevent chargebacks

patterns.routing_rationale: Same-actor filter: SC-R1-018 actor=marketplace, SC-R1-034 actor=seller, SC-R1-037 actor=buyer. Not all same actor — filter does not apply. However, these cards describe different mechanisms: Polo A covers Gumroad-initiated refunds (discretionary action they can take), Polo B covers buyer-initiated chargebacks (external action they cannot block). The opposition is not about the same subject — refunds and chargebacks are distinct mechanisms. Routed rejected_grouping: different subjects, not same claim with opposite assertions.
